name: FastGPT
description: Builds AI agents on a visual Flow canvas backed by hybrid-retrieval knowledge bases, workflow and RPA nodes, bidirectional MCP, and an OpenAPI REST API.

skills.name: Knowledge Base Ingestion
skills.description: Imports txt, md, html, pdf, docx, pptx, csv and xlsx files or URLs, then chunks them with manual, direct or QA-split segmentation.

skills.name: Hybrid Retrieval Search
skills.description: Searches multiple reusable knowledge bases with hybrid retrieval and reranking, and tests recall from a single-point search panel.

skills.name: Visual Workflow Orchestration
skills.description: Composes dialogue and plugin workflows on a visual Flow canvas, chaining agent skills, RPA nodes and user-interaction steps.

skills.name: Bidirectional MCP
skills.description: Publishes apps as MCP tools and consumes external MCP servers, so FastGPT acts as both an MCP client and an MCP server.

skills.name: Call Chain Logging
skills.description: Records complete call-chain logs and conversation history for annotation, citation editing and application evaluation runs.
